subject: Corrupted DownLoad
author: ZombieTron
body:
A few people have been reporting corrupted downloads. If this happens to you, try to switch off and re-load the game before you go to the drastic step of deleting your download and re-getting it from the dash board.

Criterion Games have stated that any issues regarding the download are out of their control, if you have any issues you need to contact Microsoft Xbox Live or Sony Playstation Network direct.

Good Luck! 🙂

Edit - in addition here is some advice from a 360 gamer:

For everyone else having corruption issues:
Try just pressing A to go past the screen where it says that the update is corrupted, choose a car and go out of Burnout. Then go back in. Worked for me.

subject: Size of update on Xbox 360
author: Xandu
body:
I have verified that the update is 445.36 MB on the XBOX 360. No additional game update is required. The PS3 update is 154 MB. Seems like the 360 update is bigger because it also includes the Cagney update. The Cagney update is no longer available for the Xbox Live Marketplace.

-- The Creator --
